subject.title: feat(ui): finish cron -> Automations rename in visible strings

question: Should the Control UI adopt “Automations” as the approved user-facing scheduler name and make `/automations` the canonical URL while retaining `/cron` as a compatibility alias?
rationale: The source change is mechanically narrow, but the canonical product term and public URL are durable product-contract choices that should be confirmed across the linked RFC stack before merging individual slices.

options.title: Approve the UI naming direction
options.body: Accept “Automations” and `/automations` as the UI standard, retain `/cron` as an alias, and require focused browser proof before landing.

options.title: Keep the current URL contract
options.body: Allow copy-only consistency work but defer or remove the canonical route change until the RFC establishes an approved URL migration plan.

options.title: Pause the stack for RFC review
options.body: Defer this slice and its siblings until the naming, tool, CLI, and documentation boundaries are accepted together.

recommendation.title: Approve the UI naming direction
recommendation.body: Accept “Automations” and `/automations` as the UI standard, retain `/cron` as an alias, and require focused browser proof before landing.
